text: Mammaaksi Oromoo walgargaarsa barsiisu “Harki harka …” jedha. Jechi bakka duwwaa guutu kami?
gloss: The Oromo proverb that teaches mutual help says “A hand … a hand.” Which word fills the gap? — Washes (dhiqa): “Harki harka dhiqa”, one hand washes the other.

text: Soddomii shan fi kudha shan yoo walitti ida'aman, ida'amni isaanii meeqa?
gloss: Thirty-five plus fifteen, in Oromo number words — fifty (shantama). Forty-five and forty are there for a hasty reading.

text: Sareen miila afur, lukkuun immoo miila lama qabdi. Saree sadii fi lukkuu shan walumaagalatti miila meeqa qabu?
gloss: A dog has four legs, a hen two. How many legs do three dogs and five hens have together? — 22: 3×4 + 5×2 = 12 + 10.

text: Irreechi Malkaa, ayyaanni galata Waaqaa, waggaa waggaan Bishooftuutti hora kam qarqaratti kabajama?
gloss: Irreecha Malkaa, the thanksgiving festival, is celebrated every year in Bishoftu on the shore of which lake? — Hora Arsadi. The others are real Bishoftu lakes (Kilole and Babogaya are crater lakes, Kuriftu a reservoir).

text: Caaltuun kitaaba fuula 200 qabu guyyaa guyyaatti fuula 20 dubbisti. Kitaabicha guyyaa meeqatti xumurti?
gloss: Chaltu reads 20 pages a day of a 200-page book. In how many days does she finish it? — 10 days: 200 ÷ 20.

text: Onneen nama tokkoo daqiiqaa tokkotti al 70 yoo dhahatte, daqiiqaa sadii keessatti al meeqa dhahatti?
gloss: If a person's heart beats 70 times a minute, how many times does it beat in three minutes? — 210: 70 × 3.

text: Bara 1960 Roomaatti miila duwwaa fiigee maaratoonii Olompikii kan injifate atileetiin Itoophiyaa eenyu?
gloss: Which Ethiopian athlete won the 1960 Olympic marathon in Rome running barefoot? — Abebe Bikila. Mamo Wolde won the marathon in 1968, in shoes.

text: Buddeenni (injeraan) maatii Itoophiyaa hedduu biratti guyyaa guyyaan nyaatamu, caalaatti daakuu midhaan kamii irraa tolfama?
gloss: Injera, eaten daily in many Ethiopian homes, is mostly made from the flour of which grain? — Teff (xaafii). Maize, wheat and barley are the distractors.

text: Afaan Oromootiin iddoowwan hedduun jecha “mana” jedhuun moggaafamu. Namni dhukkubsate wal'aansa argachuuf gara isa kamii deema?
gloss: In Oromo many places are named with “mana” (house). Where does a sick person go for treatment? — Mana yaalaa, “house of treatment” (clinic); the others are court, library, restaurant.

text: Meeshaan muuziqaa furtuuwwan adii fi gurraacha tartiibaan wal bira taa'an qabu kami?
gloss: Which instrument has white and black keys set in a row? — The piano. Guitar, krar and masinqo are string instruments.

text: Gammachuun gara kaabaatti deemaa jira. Mirgatti garagala, achii booda irra deebi'ee mirgatti garagala. Amma gara kamitti deemaa jira?
gloss: Gemechu walks north, turns right, then turns right again. Which way is he going now? — South: north → east → south.

text: Qubee Afaan Oromoo keessatti, akka “lafa” fi “laafaa” keessatti mul'atu, dheerinni sagalee dubbachiiftuu akkamitti barreeffama?
gloss: In Qubee, as in “lafa” (land) vs “laafaa” (soft), how is a long vowel written? — By doubling the vowel. The hudhaa (') marks the glottal stop, not length.

text: Lakkoofsa sa'aatii Itoophiyaatiin namni “sa'aatii sadii ganama” jedhu, akka sa'aatii idil-addunyaatti yoom jechuu isaati?
gloss: In Ethiopian time, someone says “three o'clock in the morning”. What time is that internationally? — 9 a.m.: the Ethiopian day is counted from 6 a.m., so add six hours.

text: Konkolaataan sa'aatii sadiitti kiiloomeetira 180 deeme. Giddugaleessaan sa'aatii tokkotti kiiloomeetira meeqa deeme?
gloss: A car travelled 180 km in three hours. How many kilometres per hour on average? — 60: 180 ÷ 3.

text: Itoophiyaa keessatti Gannaan, yeroon roobni cimaan roobu, ji'oota kamii of keessatti qabata?
gloss: In Ethiopia, which months does Ganna, the season of heavy rain, cover? — June to August. September–November is Birraa, March–May the small rains.

text: Amantaan aadaa Oromoo, kan Uumaa tokkicha qofa kabaju, maal jedhamee waamama?
gloss: What is the traditional Oromo religion, which honours a single Creator, called? — Waaqeffannaa. Qaalluu is a ritual office, Ateetee a women's rite, Siinqee a women's stick and institution.

text: Bunni Itoophiyaa irraa addunyaatti faca'e; garuu har'a biyyi buna hunda caalaa oomishu kami?
gloss: Coffee spread to the world from Ethiopia, but which country produces the most coffee today? — Brazil, far ahead of Vietnam and Colombia.

text: Fiilmii kartuunii “The Lion King” keessatti maqaan gooticha isaa, Simbaa, Afaan Suwaahiliitiin maal jechuudha?
gloss: In the cartoon “The Lion King”, what does the hero's name Simba mean in Swahili? — Lion (leenca).

text: Fulbaana irraa eegaltee ji'oota waggaa tartiibaan yoo lakkoofte, ji'i jahaffaan kami?
gloss: Counting the months in order starting from Fulbaana (September), which is the sixth? — Guraandhala (February): Fulbaana, Onkoloolessa, Sadaasa, Muddee, Amajjii, Guraandhala.

text: Qorataa yakkaa beekamaa Sherlock Holmes fi hiriyaa isaa Dr. Watson kan uume barreessaan eenyu?
gloss: Which writer created the detective Sherlock Holmes and his friend Dr Watson? — Arthur Conan Doyle. Christie and Poe also wrote detectives.

text: Sirna Gadaa keessatti lubni tokko waggaa saddeetiif aangoo qabatee booda luba itti aanuuf dabarsa. Lubni tokko erga aangoo qabatee, deebi'ee aangoo qabachuu isaatti waggaa meeqatu darba?
gloss: In the Gadaa system a class (luba) holds power for eight years, then hands over. How many years pass from a class taking power to taking it again? — 40: there are five luba, 5 × 8. 32 is the trap (the wait after leaving office).

text: Laggi Abbayyaa Naayil Adii waliin magaalaa kamitti walitti makama?
gloss: In which city does the Abbay (Blue Nile) meet the White Nile? — Khartoum. Juba lies on the White Nile only, Cairo downstream of the confluence.

text: Ifni aduu dachee gahuuf daqiiqaa saddeet fudhata. Aduun amma tasa yoo dhaamte, nuti dachee irratti yoom hubanna?
gloss: Sunlight takes eight minutes to reach Earth. If the Sun suddenly went out now, when would we notice on Earth? — After 8 minutes: the last light already on its way keeps arriving.

text: Maqaan “Finfinnee” jedhu maal irraa akka moggaafame beekama?
gloss: What is the name “Finfinnee” known to come from? — A natural spring: the hot springs of the area (today's Filwuha).

text: Magaalaan xiqqoon Arsii, Daraartuu Tulluu fi Xuruneesh Dibaabaa itti dhalatan, “warshaa atileetotaa” jedhamtee beekamtu kami?
gloss: Which small town in Arsi, birthplace of Derartu Tulu and Tirunesh Dibaba, is known as the “runners' factory”? — Bekoji. Asella is the nearby zonal capital.

text: Mootiin Mugaal Shaah Jahaan Taaj Mahaal maaliif ijaarsise?
gloss: Why did the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan have the Taj Mahal built? — As a tomb for his wife, Mumtaz Mahal.

text: Weellisaan beekamaan Alii Birraa magaalaa kamitti dhalate?
gloss: In which city was the famous singer Ali Birra born? — Dire Dawa (1950). Harar is the nearby trap.

text: Ancooteen, nyaanni aadaa hidda biqiltuu irraa qophaa'u, keessattuu naannoo kamiin beekama?
gloss: Anchote, a traditional dish made from a plant's root (Coccinia abyssinica), is especially associated with which area? — Wollega, western Oromia.

text: Biitiin tokko 0 ykn 1 qofa ta'uu danda'a. Biitii sadiin walitti qabama adda addaa meeqa barreessuu dandeessa?
gloss: A bit can only be 0 or 1. How many different combinations can you write with three bits? — 8: 2 × 2 × 2 (000 to 111).

text: “Afurtama”, “shantama” fi “sagaltama” maqaa “afur”, “shan” fi “sagal” irraa uumaman. Lakkoofsi kam sirna kana hin hordofu?
gloss: Forty, fifty and ninety are built from four, five and nine. Which number does not follow this pattern? — Digdama (20), not built from “lama” (two); jaatama, torbaatama, saddeettama come from jaha, torba, saddeet.

text: Kitaaba Qulqulluu guutuu jalqaba Afaan Oromootti hiikee bara 1899 kan maxxansiise eenyu?
gloss: Who first translated the whole Bible into Oromo and published it in 1899? — Onesimos Nesib (with Aster Ganno's help). Krapf translated only parts of the Gospels in the 1840s; Sapalo devised an Oromo script.

text: Laggi Awaash Oromiyaa keessaa ka'ee Afaar keessa yaa'a. Dhuma irratti eessatti gala?
gloss: The Awash rises in Oromia and flows through Afar. Where does it end? — Lake Abbe: it never reaches the sea. Lake Turkana is fed by the Omo.

text: Aadaa Oromoo keessatti “buna qalaa” jedhamee kan qophaa'u maali?
gloss: In Oromo tradition, what is “buna qalaa”? — Coffee beans cooked in butter, a ritual dish; leaf brew and coffee with milk are real but different.

text: Taphoota Olompikii irratti maaratoonii dubartootaa kan injifatte dubartiin Afrikaa jalqabaa eenyu?
gloss: Who was the first African woman to win the Olympic women's marathon? — Fatuma Roba, Atlanta 1996. Derartu Tulu's Olympic golds were at 10,000 m; Tigist Tufa won London, not the Olympics.

text: Lakkoofsa Roomaatiin “MCM” jedhamee kan barreeffamu meeqa?
gloss: What number is “MCM” in Roman numerals? — 1900: M = 1000, CM = 900 (a smaller numeral before a larger one is subtracted).

text: Gamoon Eiffel bara 1889 Paariisitti maaliif ijaarame?
gloss: Why was the Eiffel Tower built in Paris in 1889? — For the World's Fair (Exposition Universelle). Weather and radio were later uses that saved it from demolition.

text: Afsaanoo Giriik keessatti, ibidda waaqolii irraa hatee namootaaf kan kenne eenyu?
gloss: In Greek myth, who stole fire from the gods and gave it to humans? — Prometheus.

text: Weellisni “Ode to Joy”, faarfannaa Gamtaa Awurooppaa ta'e, sinfonii eenyuu irraa fudhatame?
gloss: “Ode to Joy”, which became the anthem of the European Union, is taken from whose symphony? — Beethoven's Ninth. Haydn wrote the melody of the German anthem, the trap.

text: Molakiyuulli bishaanii (H₂O) atoomii haayidiroojiinii lama fi oksijiinii tokko qaba. Ulfaatina bishaanii keessaa gara dhibbeentaa meeqatu oksijiinii irraa dhufa?
gloss: Water has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen. About what percentage of water's mass comes from oxygen? — About 89%: oxygen weighs 16, each hydrogen 1, so 16/18. 33% counts atoms, not mass.

text: Finfinneetti bishaan osoo digirii Selsiyesii 100 hin ga'in danfa. Sababni isaa maali?
options: Dhiibbaan qilleensaa olka'iinsa irratti waan hir'atuuf
Bishaan isaa ashaboo waan hin qabneef
gloss: In Addis Ababa water boils before reaching 100 °C. Why? — Air pressure is lower at altitude (about 2,400 m), so water boils at about 92 °C.

text: Haroota Itoophiyaa hunda keessaa kan gad-fageenya guddaa qabu kami?
gloss: Which is the deepest lake in Ethiopia? — Lake Shala (about 266 m), right next to the shallow Lake Abijata in the Rift Valley.

text: Maqaan dhaabbata meeshaalee ispoortii “Adidas” jedhu eessaa dhufe?
options: Maqaa hundeessaa isaa, Adolf “Adi” Dassler, irraa
gloss: Where does the sportswear brand name “Adidas” come from? — Its founder Adolf “Adi” Dassler (Adi + Das). The Greek goddess of victory is Nike, the trap.

text: Johannes Gutenberg maashina maxxansaa qubee sochoo'aa qabu magaalaa kamitti hojiirra oolche?
gloss: In which city did Johannes Gutenberg put his movable-type printing press to work? — Mainz, his home town, where the Gutenberg Bible was printed.

text: Jechi “roboot” jalqaba diraamaa bara 1920 barreeffame tokko keessatti uumame. Jechi kun afaan kamii irraa dhufe?
gloss: The word “robot” was coined in a play written in 1920. Which language does it come from? — Czech: Karel Čapek's R.U.R., from “robota” (forced labour).

text: Asoosama Ernest Hemingway “The Old Man and the Sea” keessatti jaarsi qurxummii qabu namni biyya kamii?
gloss: In Hemingway's “The Old Man and the Sea”, which country is the old fisherman from? — Cuba: Santiago fishes off Havana.

text: Akka seenaa hidda dhalootaa Oromootti, Oromoon ilmaan lama irraa dhalate jedhama: Booranaa fi obboleessa isaa. Inni kun eenyu?
gloss: By Oromo traditional genealogy, the Oromo descend from two sons: Borana and his brother. Who? — Barentu. Tulama and Macha are branches of Borana, Arsi a branch of Barentu.

text: Ji'i dachee marsa, garuu yeroo hunda fuula isaa tokko qofa nutti agarsiisa. Maaliif?
options: Dacheen fuula isaa kaan ni dhoksiti
Of naannessuu fi dachee marsuun isaa yeroo walqixa fudhatu
Aduun cinaa isaa tokko qofa ifsiti
gloss: The Moon orbits Earth but always shows us the same face. Why? — It turns once on its axis in exactly the time it takes to orbit Earth. “It doesn't rotate” is the common wrong answer.

text: Vaniilaan, mi'eessituu beekamtuu, firii biqiltuu maatii kamii?
gloss: Vanilla, the famous flavouring, is the fruit of a plant from which family? — The orchids. The pea family is the trap, since vanilla pods are called “beans”.

text: Awustiraaliyaa, magaalaa Sidnii keessatti, walakkaa guyyaa aduun samii keessatti gara kamiin mul'atti?
gloss: In Sydney, Australia, in which direction is the Sun at midday? — North: Sydney lies south of the Tropic of Capricorn, so the noon Sun is always to its north.

text: Ispoortiin basketboolii bara 1891 eenyuun uumame?
gloss: Who invented basketball in 1891? — James Naismith. Morgan invented volleyball, Coubertin revived the Olympics, Camp shaped American football.
